object.attr: An empty value differs from zero: History and Summary hide the heart rate cells when the value is empty. The value is in whole bpm. Time weighting stops a brief noisy stretch from skewing the average. Basis: as implemented.
object.description: When a session finishes, the app shall store the average and maximum heart rate of the session as defined in PACE-SRS-90 and PACE-SRS-91, leaving each empty without readings.
